mapper.sql: prescription_id AS prescriptionId, register_id AS registerId, patient_id AS patientId, doctor_id AS doctorId, prescription_date AS prescriptionDate, drug_info AS drugInfo, diagnosis, total_fee AS totalFee, status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM prescription ORDER BY prescription_date DESC
SELECT FROM prescription ORDER BY prescription_date DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM prescription WHERE prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM prescription WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY prescription_date ASC
SELECT FROM prescription WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY prescription_date DESC
SELECT FROM prescription WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY prescription_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prescription(register_id, patient_id, doctor_id, prescription_date, drug_info, diagnosis, total_fee, status) VALUES(#{registerId}, #{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{prescriptionDate}, #{drugInfo}, #{diagnosis}, #{totalFee}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription SET register_id = #{registerId}, patient_id = #{patientId}, doctor_id = #{doctorId}, prescription_date = #{prescriptionDate}, drug_info = #{drugInfo}, diagnosis = #{diagnosis}, total_fee = #{totalFee}, status = #{status} WHERE prescription_id = #{prescriptionId}
